requirements.text: Scenario 1 - Foreground watcher: Run/Stop update status, checkboxes + received list present
requirements.reason: Full 5/5 coverage; Run and Stop both produce live status changes.

requirements.text: Scenario 2 - Foreground publisher: Run/Stop update status, payload displayed
requirements.reason: Run reports 'Publisher started.' + payload + RadioNotAvailable (hardware-gated, faithful); Stop reports 'Publisher stopped.'

requirements.text: Scenario 3 - Background watcher: Run registers task + updates status, Stop unregisters
requirements.reason: Run button DEAD: invoke succeeds but no status appears and Stop stays disabled; no task registered.
requirements.suspected_skill_gap: In-process background-task model (BackgroundTaskBuilder with no TaskEntryPoint + App.OnBackgroundActivated) not covered by the skill; WinUI 3 Application has no OnBackgroundActivated so registration fails silently. Validator's windows.backgroundTasks check passed (extension present) and missed it.

requirements.text: Scenario 4 - Background publisher: Run registers publisher task + updates status, Stop unregisters
requirements.reason: Run button DEAD: PublisherStatusBlock stays empty and Stop stays disabled.
requirements.suspected_skill_gap: Same in-process background-task defect + validator blind spot as Scenario 3.

visual_discrepancies.uwp: Source always NotifyUser's registered / cannot-register / disabled status
Source registers publisher trigger and reports a status

missing_features: Background (in-process) task registration feedback in Scenarios 3 & 4
summary: Structural parity is full (100% control coverage, non-blank). Two behavioral regressions: the background scenarios ported the UWP in-process background-task model (TaskEntryPoint omitted + App.OnBackgroundActivated), which has no WinUI 3 equivalent, so the Run controls are silently dead. The skill covers only the out-of-process model and its validator check passes on the present manifest extension, hiding the failure.
